description: Gaia DR2 revised passbands based on updated nominal instrument knowledge and BP/RP spectral data, providing improved G, BP and RP passbands for synthetic photometry.
short_description: Gaia DR2 revised passbands (Evans et al. 2018)
facility_description: Gaia is a European Space Agency astrometric, photometric and spectroscopic space observatory operating at the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point.
notes: Gaia DR2 revised passbands based on the nominal instrument knowledge (Evans et al. 2018, A&A 616, A4). Whole-instrument (telescope optics, filter/prisms, CCD QE) transmissivities for CCD photometry (DetectorType=photon). DetectorType is left unchanged. Distinct from GAIA/DR2 (the release-processing version) and GAIA/GAIA (EDR3/DR3, Gaia2m BP bright/faint).

BP.DetectorType_note: SVO's GAIA/GAIA2r.Gbp (captured 2023-01-27) is NJM's curve multiplied by wavelength (SVO/NJM ∝ λ^1.000, rms 0.0000), i.e. the energy form of the same passband, and SVO labels it energy. NJM keeps Evans et al. (2018, A&A 616, A4, Eq. 2; doi:10.1051/0004-6361/201832756) photonic passband, which integrates as photon. The two labels are consistent; no conflict.
